item.title: Futari no Qualia
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: 10mile
  • 発売日: 2014-07-25
  • スコア: 6.49/10 (43 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ふたりのクオリア
  • 英語名: Futari no Qualia

别名

  • Both Qualia

あらすじ

One night, Natsume came upon the beautiful Ginza passed out on the street and took her home. Ginza got better under her care, but she didn’t seem like she wanted to leave. Natsume felt a strange sense of satisfaction from taking care of the free Ginza, who lacked common sense. However, there was a problem: she lived in an apartment for singles. If their cohabitation was found out, then they might be kicked out. What will they do with their futures?

item.title: Hitori no Qualia
item.description:

  • ブランド: 10mile

  • スコア: 6.37/10 (65 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ひとりのクオリア
  • 英語名: Hitori no Qualia

别名

  • Only Qualia

あらすじ

The mysterious girl Karin saved Makiri who carelessly walked out into the road. Makiri showered her with thanks, but it was a bit too close for Karin who refrained from interacting with others. However, Makiri’s purity helped Karin open her heart to her. Afterwards, they started living together. That’s when Karin found out that Makiri didn’t go to school and just played games all day. She decided to help her new friend who’s a hikikomori beyond her imagination by all means possible.

item.title: Mazo x Love
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: 10mile
  • 発売日: 2009-08-28
  • スコア: 7.5/10 (37 人評価)
  • 日本語名: マゾ×ラブ
  • 英語名: Mazo x Love

别名

  • Mazolove

あらすじ

Soji, who makes a living selling Doujin books, yearns for a common love. One day, he finds Yuzu, whom he is secretly in love with, being surrounded by thugs. Soji bravely tries to stop it, but he finds himself being in the hospital when he regains his consciousness. “Oh, I can’t even save a girl I love….” Soji soon leaves the hospital with a broken heart…. But three beautiful girls await him. Yuzu says, “You saved me, didn’t you?” Yuto, the police officer, says, “You beat the thugs nearly to death, didn’t you?” Ranka, a nurse, says, “Do you have a girlfriend…?” “Well, what’s going on? It must be a dream!?” No one notices yet that something evil has woken up in his brain….
